extracted.name: Margarita Recipe
extracted.description: Our best margarita recipe! This classic cocktail is tart, refreshing, and easy to make. It's perfect for Cinco de Mayo, summer gatherings, or any happy hour.
ingredient_lines: 1 ounce orange liqueur (like Cointreau, Grand Marnier, or Triple Sec)
1 ounce fresh lime juice (plus lime slices for garnish)
½ ounce agave nectar or simple syrup (plus more to taste)
Lime wedge and coarse salt (for the glass rim (optional))
instruction_lines: Salt the rim of the glass (optional): Rub a lime wedge around the rim of a rocks glass. Fill a small plate with coarse salt. Dip the glass into the salt to coat the rim. Fill with ice.

Place the tequila, orange liqueur, lime juice, and agave in a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake and strain into the glass. Taste and stir in more agave nectar, if desired. Garnish with lime slices and serve.
